findings.V2022: S0 equals C0; it tied C0 on wOBA and runs RMSE and lost proper scores to Marcel, so strict improvement was impossible
findings.V2023: S0 improved log loss in both views and all four PA-weighted primary metrics, but worsened player-weighted Brier, wOBA RMSE, and runs_per_600 RMSE
findings.V2024: S0 improved log loss in both views but worsened Brier, wOBA RMSE, and runs_per_600 RMSE in both views
findings.pooled: only PA-weighted log loss cleared its required relative-improvement minimum; the other seven metric-view cells failed
findings.correlation: V2023 and V2024 passed correlation guardrails; V2022 did not
findings.calibration: S0 failed every calibration family in every fold
findings.subgroups: V2023 and V2024 had no material supported-subgroup reversal; V2022 inherited C0 proper-score reversals against Marcel

scientific_interpretation: a single global Marcel blend slightly stabilizes log loss but dilutes the player-level outcome signal that makes C0 useful for future offense
